notes: Minimap correction: the optional Oak radar is always north-up, with the custom exterior wooden N/E/S/W plaques restored. Old rotation settings no longer affect it; compass, champions and Choir Singers remain unchanged.

Minimap is fully optional and off by default, including a one-time reset of older saved radar choices. North-up is now the default; players can still choose a turning map. Compass and Champion/Choir Singer markers remain independent and intact.
Expansive Inventory: after a server crash, your pages still open. A page you switched away from is kept 2 hours before it is cleaned up, and page switches no longer fail after a crash.

Quick Stack & Sort: /realm:sort and Sort my inventory now sort every inventory page together: like stacks merge across pages and the sorted stacks fill page 1 first, then page 2 and on. /realm:inv adds Sort all pages; Sort this page still sorts only the page you see.
Minimap: champions show as a red dot in a bright orange ring on the compass strip and radar, within 128 blocks and at the edges when out of sight.
Choir sieges: the Choir Singer has a red name and shows on the Minimap like a champion, so a Singer that wandered off is easy to find.

Minimap: uses about half the server time it did; with many players moving the radar's land and mob dots catch up a few seconds later. Operators can pick High in /realm:config -> Minimap for the earlier behavior.
Silly Enchants costs less on a busy server: its every-tick checks run only while someone wears Hyper Jump boots.
Expedition dungeons build in shorter steps, so a busy server no longer hitches while one is built.
Champions cost less at night: their aura and approach read less from the game.
Champions: a player who leaves the game with the Champions menu open no longer leaves an error in the server log.
Town Projects: removing a build puts back only the town's own blocks, so your blocks there stay even when they are the same kind (cobblestone by a well, dirt on its ground).
Town Projects: a removed town's villagers move away instead of staying behind, and a garden pen never ends up with extra animals.
Town Projects: a new town build no longer walls in a villager, pet or animal standing on its spot; they are moved aside first.

Minimap: the radar is now a 33 x 33 circle that reaches 36 blocks and starts off; players who had it on are switched off once. North up shows fixed N, E, S and W badges. /realm:minimap scan <1-384, default 64>, status and cancel map the land around you; unknown land and estimates are marked, and the Nether map follows your floor.
Side boxes: the HUD packs (Calendar, Elytra, HUD, Maps, Mob HP, Story) carry the new radar size; Help and the Realm Configuration menu describe the new Minimap commands.
resourceNotes: Side HUD correction: the original wooden cardinal plaque images stay visible whenever the optional radar is displayed; remove the incompatible rotation-flag visibility gate without resizing the frame or terrain.
Side HUD: new Minimap icons for champions and Choir Singers (a red dot in a bright orange ring, and its edge arrows).
Easy Building's resources: line endings tidied (no change for players).
Side HUD: the Minimap's circular 33 x 33 radar art, fixed N/E/S/W badges, and the unknown and estimate terrain glyphs.

map_bp.notes: Restore the intended always-north-up Oak radar. Ignore old player/world rotation values and remove the obsolete rotation menu options. Preserve radar-off defaults, existing once-only radar reset, later opt-ins, compass and Champion/Singer markers.

town_bp.notes: Remove spot never touches your blocks, even of a kind the build uses; builds move mobs and dropped items aside instead of walling them in; a removed town's residents move away (what they carry drops); the garden pen keeps exactly its 2 sheep and 2 chickens; spot picking does less work per spot.

npc_bp.notes: Town mayors: each town can have its own mayor who takes deliveries for that town; mayors share town news.

welcome_bp.notes: The welcome page lists Town Projects: towns that grow as you help, each with its mayor.

admin_bp.notes: The Realm Configuration menu lists /realm:minimap's new scan radius (Integer 1 to 384, default 64), status and cancel.

silly_bp.notes: Cheaper on busy servers: nothing runs every tick unless someone wears Hyper Jump boots or is mid-flight.

expedition_bp.notes: Dungeon builds and resets spread their work over more, shorter steps: no build step holds a server tick for long.

elite_bp.notes: A player who leaves with the Champions menu open no longer leaves an error in the server log.

stash_bp.notes: Sorting your inventory (/realm:sort, Sort my inventory, and the new Sort all pages in /realm:inv) sorts every page as one: like stacks merge across pages, then stacks are ordered by item and refill page 1, page 2 and on. Slot-locked stacks and the buttons stay; all pages commit together or nothing changes. Crash-safe pages: a replaced page snapshot is retired and deleted 120 minutes later (stash:retired, at most 32 a minute, 1500 waiting), so an index a crash rolled back still finds its pages; a snapshot sequence a crash rolled back steps past the snapshots still on disk instead of failing the switch.

calendar_bp.notes: Reads the Minimap's new 33 x 33 radar wire (a fixed 3-byte self slot plus a 1/0 north flag) from the shared side boxes protocol copy; no change to your readout.

hud_rp.notes: Restore all four original exterior wooden N/E/S/W plaque images as unconditional radar children. Parent radar visibility still hides the whole widget when off. Artwork, frame fit, terrain mesh, placement and self-arrow geometry unchanged.
